relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: The administration of different doses (0.03, 0.3, and 3.0 μg/20 μL) of capsaicin, menthol, and methyl salicylate in the different pain models (neuropathic, inflammatory, and nociceptive) induced antinociception in most of the evaluated time points.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: we suggest that the activation of TRPV1, TRPM8, and TRPA1 receptors results in the antinociceptive effect of the stimulation of the ST36 acupoint

key_findings: Subcutaneous TRP agonists (capsaicin, menthol, methyl salicylate) at ST36 attenuated nociception in neuropathic, inflammatory and acute pain models in rats
